sections.title: Player bullets
items: You are escorting one sealed cargo unit.
It is important, guarded, and not supposed to be opened without permission.
It is going to Hush, a village in the Goldspire Territories.
The route crosses Sablewood Logistics Preserve: a vast fantasy forest, called Old Sable by some locals.
You begin inside the system: loyal, ignorant, conflicted, pragmatic, or simply hired.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Align starting knowledge without leaking hidden information.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Script: Read the player-safe starting knowledge. Keep the hidden facts in GM view only and use them for foreshadowing, not for projection.
Player-safe knowledge should be concrete enough to start play.
Do not show hidden knowledge on the player display.
Checklist: Starting knowledge aligned; Hidden knowledge kept GM-only
GM-only: Keystone's real ward function; Ward network soul-economy implications; Bramble Union's deeper motives; Final ritual threat; Relay Spire hook
